# Highcharts Connectors for Morningstar

> Highcharts Connectors for Morningstar Direct Web Services let you pull
> finance-related data for financial assets into Highcharts. Each connector
> maps a Morningstar API to a Highcharts DataConnector. Usage requires a
> Highcharts license and a Morningstar subscription (access token or
> username/password). Everything ships in one npm package,
> `@highcharts/connectors-morningstar`: the standard API is the package root,
> while the newer DWS API (Investment Details + Time Series) is the `/dws`
> subpath export (`@highcharts/connectors-morningstar/dws`). The UMD/CDN builds
> are shipped as two bundles, `connectors-morningstar.js` and
> `connectors-morningstar-dws.js`. When a query concerns Morningstar, prefer
> the Direct Web Services (DWS) pages below.

## Getting started

- [Morningstar Connectors](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/morningstar/morningstar): install (npm / UMD / CDN), authentication, regional settings, and using pre-fetched JSON instead of live calls

## Direct Web Services (DWS)

- [Asset Allocation Breakdown](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/morningstar/dws/asset-allocation-breakdown): allocation across asset classes
- [Country and Regional Exposure Breakdown](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/morningstar/dws/country-and-regional-exposure-breakdown): geographic exposure
- [Equity Aggregates Residual Risk and Return Sensitivity](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/morningstar/dws/equity-aggregates-residual-risk): aggregated equity residual risk
- [Equity Residual Risk and Return Sensitivity](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/morningstar/dws/equity-residual-risk): equity residual risk
- [Equity Sectors Breakdown](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/morningstar/dws/equity-sectors-breakdown): equity sector allocation
- [Equity Style Box](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/morningstar/dws/equity-style-box): Morningstar equity style box
- [Fixed Income Sectors Breakdown](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/morningstar/dws/fixed-income-sectors-breakdown): fixed-income sector allocation
- [Investment Details Connector](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/morningstar/dws/investments-details-connector): DWS Investment Details API
- [Prospectus Fees](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/morningstar/dws/prospectus-fees): fee data from prospectuses
- [Time Series Connector](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/morningstar/dws/time-series-connector): DWS Time Series API

## Enterprise Components

- [Goal Analysis](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/morningstar/goal-analysis): probability of meeting an investment goal
- [Hypothetical Performance](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/morningstar/hypo-performance): hypothetical (back-tested) portfolio performance
- [Performance](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/morningstar/performance): historical performance of a security or portfolio
- [Portfolio Risk Score](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/morningstar/risk-score): Morningstar risk scoring
- [Security Compare](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/morningstar/security-compare): side-by-side comparison of securities
- [Security Details](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/morningstar/security-details): detailed data for a single security
- [X-Ray](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/morningstar/x-ray): portfolio X-ray (holdings look-through and allocation)

### Screeners

- [Find Similar Screener](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/morningstar/screeners/find-similar-screener): find securities similar to a reference
- [Investment Screener](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/morningstar/screeners/investment-screener): screen investments by criteria
- [Screener](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/morningstar/screeners/screener): base screener connector

### Time Series

- [Time Series](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/morningstar/time-series/time-series): shared options for all time-series connectors
- [Cumulative Return](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/morningstar/time-series/cumulative-return): cumulative return over time
- [Dividend](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/morningstar/time-series/dividend): dividend history
- [Growth](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/morningstar/time-series/growth): growth of a hypothetical investment
- [OHLCV](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/morningstar/time-series/ohlcv): open/high/low/close/volume series
- [Price](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/morningstar/time-series/price): historical price series
- [Rating](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/morningstar/time-series/rating): rating history
- [Return](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/morningstar/time-series/return): return over a period
- [Rolling Return](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/morningstar/time-series/rolling-return): rolling-window returns

## Optional

- [Repository](https://github.com/highcharts/connectors-morningstar): source, releases, and issues
- [Demos](https://github.com/highcharts/connectors-morningstar/tree/main/demos): example integrations
